q: For a continuous map T on a compact metric space with a unique measure of maximal entropy μ_max, the topological entropy can be computed from the growth rate of periodic orbits:
opts: (1/n) log |Fix(Tⁿ)| → h_top(T) as n → ∞ (for expansive maps or when periodic orbits are dense)
All periodic orbits have the same period
exp: For expansive maps with specification property (e.g., mixing SFTs, Axiom A attractors): (1/n) log |Per_n(T)| → h_top. For the full k-shift: |Per_n| = kⁿ, giving entropy log k. This is the dynamical analogue of Dirichlet series counting prime orbits.
